correctness.rationale: For each of sixteen disjoint four-bit prefixes, one ending is compulsory, so size is at least 16. The exact in-ball formula yields ten singleton symmetric differences, two triple differences, and four paired binary differences that force fourteen distinct codewords. Two choices at each remaining prefix leave exactly four candidates, and all four have 32 nonempty distinct identifying signatures. The full 128 signature rows and independent Python/C++ exact graph methods agree on masks 6949,6951,23333,23335. There is no extrapolation beyond the finite graph.
correctness.risk: The result is parameter-specific; no all-alphabet or all-radius claim is made.
